author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam Savage takes a look at malicious hardware devices hidden in plain sight and gets a demonstration of how they actually work. From USB keyboards to webcams, here are hacked pieces of PC hardware the team at Threatlocker have encountered in the field.
